data.one_liner: Dart-native client for Firebase Auth and Firestore without native SDKs.
data.what_it_does: Provides Email/Password, anonymous and custom token authentication and basic Firestore CRUD operations. Works in pure Dart environments and Flutter on all platforms.
use_when: You need Firebase Auth or Firestore in a pure‑Dart or non‑mobile environment
You want to avoid native Firebase SDKs and their platform setup
avoid_when: You require full Firestore query support (filters, ordering, etc.)
You need automatic token persistence or secure storage out of the box
strengths: Runs everywhere Dart runs, no native plugins
Supports token stores via custom implementations

alternatives.name: firebase_core
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Firebase core package with full platform support

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Firestore client with complete query features

alternatives.name: firebase_auth_web
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Auth client for web, works with other firebase_core packages
